cues.en: So far in this section, you have seen a few different ways to identify individual MLP neurons to zero
cues.zh: 這個章節到目前為止，你看過幾種方式，辨識要在前向傳播中歸零的個別 MLP

cues.en: out in a forward pass.
cues.zh: 神經元。

cues.en: For example, removal based on high activation values and based on statistical tests using independent data.
cues.zh: 例如，根據高活化值，或使用獨立資料做統計檢定，來移除。

cues.en: The approach that I will introduce here in this video is about using matrix decomposition methods to identify subspaces.
cues.zh: 這支影片要介紹的方法，是使用矩陣分解辨識子空間。

cues.en: So these are linear combinations of all the neurons to project out of the data.
cues.zh: 也就是所有神經元的線性組合，再將它們從資料中投影移除。

cues.en: It's kind of like the opposite of using PCA for compression and noise attenuation.
cues.zh: 有點像用 PCA 壓縮、削弱雜訊的相反操作。

cues.en: That is to say normally subspace rejection is used to get rid of very small dimensions in the data that are probably just noise.
cues.zh: 也就是說，一般的子空間剔除，用來移除資料中很小、可能只是雜訊的維度。

cues.en: In contrast, what I'm going to show you here is using PCA to identify the largest and the highest variance component.
cues.zh: 相反地，這裡會用 PCA 辨識最大、變異數最高的成分。

cues.en: And then I will project that out of the data.
cues.zh: 再把它從資料中投影移除。

cues.en: Importantly, the data set size will remain exactly the same.
cues.zh: 重點是，資料集大小完全不變。

cues.en: So we can project out a component without actually zeroing out any individual neuron or sets of neurons.
cues.zh: 所以，可以移除一個成分，而不真的將任何個別神經元或一組神經元歸零。

cues.en: It's a pretty neat approach conceptually, and it allows for lots of hypotheses to be tested about latent components and linear combinations of neurons or dimensions.
cues.zh: 概念上相當巧妙，讓我們能檢驗許多關於潛在成分，以及神經元或維度線性組合的假設。

cues.en: I will start by giving you a brief reminder of how we can decompose a data set using the SVD, the singular
cues.zh: 先簡短複習，如何使用 SVD，也就是奇異

cues.en: value decomposition, and then I'll switch to what we're going to do in the code demo.
cues.zh: 值分解，來分解資料集，再介紹程式示範。

cues.en: You have seen a slide that looks like this several times before in this course.
cues.zh: 這門課之前已經看過幾次類似投影片。

cues.en: And if you've taken my linear algebra course then you've also seen this slide quite a few times.
cues.zh: 如果上過我的線性代數課，也看過很多次。

cues.en: So imagine we have the MLP data set here on the left.
cues.zh: 想像左邊是 MLP 資料集。

cues.en: It is tokens by neurons or dimensions.
cues.zh: 大小是 token 乘上神經元或維度。

cues.en: In fact, the full data set could also have a third dimension that would correspond to sequences in the batch.
cues.zh: 其實，完整資料集也可能有第三維，對應批次中的序列。

cues.en: But I'm going to ignore that for simplicity.
cues.zh: 但為了簡單，先忽略。

cues.en: The singular value decomposition allows us to decompose this matrix into the product of three other matrices.
cues.zh: 奇異值分解，能把這個矩陣分解成其他三個矩陣的乘積。

cues.en: We have the token basis, the singular values matrix embedded in the diagonals of this matrix sigma,
cues.zh: 有 token 基底、嵌在 Sigma 矩陣對角線上的奇異值矩陣，

cues.en: and we have the MLP basis vectors.
cues.zh: 以及 MLP 基底向量。

cues.en: Now if you're doing a principal components analysis, then you would take the columns of U or the rows
cues.zh: 做主成分分析時，可以把 U 的欄，或 V 轉置的列，

cues.en: of V transpose as the eigenvectors or the principal components, and also as another reminder from earlier
cues.zh: 當作特徵向量、主成分。也再次提醒課程前面提過的，

cues.en: in this course, the first row of V transpose, which is associated with the largest singular value.
cues.zh: V 轉置第一列，對應最大奇異值，

cues.en: That's the one up here on the top left, that is a vector that points in the direction in the data space with the largest variance.
cues.zh: 也就是左上方那個，它是指向資料空間中最大變異數方向的向量。

cues.en: So the largest covariance across all the variables.
cues.zh: 也就是所有變數之間，最大的共變異數。

cues.en: So that would be this axis over here.
cues.zh: 對應這裡這個軸。

cues.en: Now what I am going to do here in this video is set this largest singular value to zero.
cues.zh: 這支影片，我要把這個最大奇異值設為零。

cues.en: That will effectively remove that dimension from the data.
cues.zh: 這實際上會從資料移除那個維度。

cues.en: That is not the same as zeroing out any individual neuron or even a set of neurons.
cues.zh: 與將任何個別神經元，甚至一組神經元歸零，不一樣。

cues.en: In fact, all of the neurons retain some numerical value that is pretty close to their original value, which I will demonstrate to you in the code demo.
cues.zh: 事實上，所有神經元都保留某個與原始值相當接近的數值，程式示範會展示。

cues.en: The cool thing about this subspace removal technique is that it will preserve the dimensionality of
cues.zh: 這個子空間移除技術，很棒的一點，是保留

cues.en: the data matrix, and that means that we can manipulate this MLP data matrix inside a hook function,
cues.zh: 資料矩陣的維度，代表可以在 hook 函數內操作這個 MLP 資料矩陣，

cues.en: and then pass it along back into the model to continue with the forward pass calculations.
cues.zh: 再傳回模型，繼續前向傳播計算。

cues.en: And so with that in mind, I will now give you an overview of the code demo before switching to code.
cues.zh: 記住這點，切換到程式碼前，先概述示範。

cues.en: I'm going to work with the Excel version of GPT two, in part because it's just fun to work with these
cues.zh: 使用 GPT2 的 XL 版本，部分原因是使用

cues.en: slightly bigger models, and also in part just to demonstrate how robust this method is to the data
cues.zh: 稍大模型很好玩，另一部分則是展示，這個方法對資料集

cues.en: set size, which means it's a useful method that can be scaled up to much larger models.
cues.zh: 大小很穩健，代表能擴展到大得多的模型。

cues.en: For example, there are 6400 neurons in the expansion layer of the MLP, and the SVD on this data set
cues.zh: 例如，MLP 擴張層有 6400 個神經元，對這份資料做 SVD，

cues.en: is going to run quite fast, in part because this is actually not the relevant dimensionality for an SVD complexity.
cues.zh: 仍然會很快，部分是因為這其實不是 SVD 複雜度相關的維度。

cues.en: The relevant dimensionality is actually the token dimensionality.
cues.zh: 真正相關的，是 token 維度。

cues.en: So the number of tokens.
cues.zh: 也就是 token 數量。

cues.en: So therefore to have some tokens to work with, I took the first paragraph of this Wikipedia page about Ravel.
cues.zh: 所以，為了取得一些 token，我從介紹 Ravel 的維基百科頁面，取了第一段。

cues.en: Ravel is one of my favorite composers, and if you've never heard his music before, I can recommend giving it a listen.
cues.zh: Ravel 是我最喜歡的作曲家之一，如果沒聽過他的音樂，可以聽聽看。

cues.en: Anyway, I'm going to forward pass some text here and grab the MLP activations before the Jlu non-linearity.
cues.zh: 總之，讓一些文字做前向傳播，取得 GELU 非線性函數之前的 MLP 活化。

cues.en: As you've now seen many times before, the MLP activations tend to look roughly normally distributed and shifted to the left of zero.
cues.zh: 你已經看過很多次，MLP 活化通常大致呈常態分布，往零的左邊偏移。

cues.en: Here is the key part of the code that implements the subspace removal.
cues.zh: 這是實作子空間移除的關鍵程式碼。

cues.en: So this matrix here is MLP.
cues.zh: 這個矩陣是 MLP。

cues.en: This is tokens by neurons.
cues.zh: 大小是 token 乘上神經元。

cues.en: And in this SVD function, the second output is a vector of singular values.
cues.zh: SVD 函數的第二個輸出，是奇異值向量。

cues.en: And by the way, earlier in this course I was using numpy to calculate the SVD.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，課程前面，是用 NumPy 計算 SVD。

cues.en: But the torch dot linalg module has very similar functionality.
cues.zh: 但 torch.linalg 模組，有非常相似的功能。

cues.en: Anyway, we need S to be converted from a vector into the sigma matrix, which is easy to do.
cues.zh: 總之，需要把 S 從向量轉成 Sigma 矩陣，很容易做到。

cues.en: And then here I'm simply zeroing out the top component simply by setting the first singular value to
cues.zh: 接著，只要把第一個奇異值設為

cues.en: zero.
cues.zh: 零，就把最前面的成分歸零。

cues.en: We don't actually have to manipulate the U or the v transpose matrix, because the largest component
cues.zh: 其實不必操作 U 或 V 轉置矩陣，因為 U 與 V 轉置中

cues.en: in U and v transpose will multiply by this zero, and then they will effectively be zeroed out.
cues.zh: 最大的成分，會乘上這個零，因此實際上被歸零。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So then I just have to multiply these three matrices back together to reconstruct the data without the top component.
cues.zh: 再把三個矩陣乘回去，重建不含最前面成分的資料。

cues.en: Here you see the size of the matrix, and that's actually the same size as the MLP matrix up here.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到矩陣大小，其實與上面的 MLP 矩陣相同。

cues.en: So what is the impact of this subspace removal.
cues.zh: 子空間移除有什麼影響？

cues.en: We can explore that by comparing various data metrics between the MLP and the proj variables here.
cues.zh: 可以比較這裡 MLP 與 proj 變數的各種資料指標，來探索。

cues.en: So here you see several ways of comparing them.
cues.zh: 這裡有幾種比較方式。

cues.en: The first one up here is a scatter plot.
cues.zh: 首先，上面是散布圖。

cues.en: This shows the original data by the reconstructed data with the first subspace removed.
cues.zh: 顯示原始資料，相對於移除第一個子空間後的重建資料。

cues.en: They are certainly not identical, but they're also certainly very strongly correlated.
cues.zh: 兩者當然不相同，但也確實非常強烈相關。

cues.en: And it's clearly not the case that I have just zeroed out lots of individual neurons.
cues.zh: 而且，顯然不是單純把很多個別神經元歸零。

cues.en: Their distributions look somewhat similar, although it looks like the largest component was accounting for some of this stuff here on the side lobe here.
cues.zh: 分布看起來有些相似，但最大成分似乎解釋了這裡旁瓣的某些部分。

cues.en: Actually, there is some nuance here about putting the mean value, the average value back into the data, which I will demonstrate in the code.
cues.zh: 其實，關於把平均值加回資料，有一些細節，程式碼中會展示。

cues.en: Over here we have the eigen spectra of the two matrices.
cues.zh: 這裡是兩個矩陣的特徵值譜。

cues.en: So these are the scree plots from a principal components analysis.
cues.zh: 也就是主成分分析的陡坡圖。

cues.en: And this pink box up here.
cues.zh: 上面這個粉紅方框，

cues.en: This is the component that I removed from the data.
cues.zh: 就是從資料移除的成分。

cues.en: It accounts for like 36 or 37% of the variance of the total MLP data set from this transformer block.
cues.zh: 它解釋這個 Transformer 區塊，全部 MLP 資料集大約 36% 或 37% 變異數。

cues.en: And of course after I remove this component, then there's no longer one big component that accounts for lots of variance in the data.
cues.zh: 移除成分後，當然就不再有一個能解釋大量變異數的大成分。

cues.en: These two plots down here show the covariance matrices of the data.
cues.zh: 下面這兩張圖，是資料的共變異數矩陣。

cues.en: And they are really remarkably different.
cues.zh: 差異真的非常明顯。

cues.en: You really see that removing the largest one dimensional subspace did not really impact the individual
cues.zh: 可以看到，移除最大的單維子空間，沒有太大影響個別

cues.en: data values that much, but it had a really striking impact on the relationships across the different neurons.
cues.zh: 資料值，卻對不同神經元之間的關係，有非常醒目的影響。

cues.en: This demonstrates that there are embedded multi-variable patterns in the data that were destroyed by removing that top principal component subspace.
cues.zh: 這顯示，資料中嵌有多變量模式，移除最前面的主成分子空間，會破壞它們。

cues.en: That's also really clear when looking at these distributions here, which show the histograms of the covariance values.
cues.zh: 這些分布也很清楚，顯示共變異數值的直方圖。

cues.en: So the covariance is in the raw data are generally pretty strong and shifted towards the right towards positive values.
cues.zh: 原始資料的共變異數，一般相當強，往右、往正值偏移。

cues.en: Whereas the reconstructed data with the subspace removed have a distribution that is actually a little bit shifted towards negative.
cues.zh: 移除子空間的重建資料，分布則反而稍微偏向負值。

cues.en: So quite a striking result.
cues.zh: 相當醒目的結果。

cues.en: Anyway, the next thing I did was implement this manipulation in one layer.
cues.zh: 接著，我把這個操作實作在一層。

cues.en: Only one layer of the model in the middle of the transformer block sequence, and then measure what happens to the hidden states for all the layers in the model.
cues.zh: 只有模型一層，在 Transformer 區塊序列中間，再測量模型全部層的隱藏狀態發生什麼。

cues.en: The way that I quantified this was by comparing the hidden states for the clean model of clean version of the model versus the subspace removed version of the model.
cues.zh: 量化方式，是比較乾淨模型版本，以及移除子空間模型版本的隱藏狀態。

cues.en: So the y axis here is the norm of that vector difference.
cues.zh: 所以，y 軸是向量差的範數。

cues.en: You've seen this matrix before.
cues.zh: 這個指標以前看過。

cues.en: It doesn't tell us exactly what is changing or how it's changing.
cues.zh: 不會告訴我們，確切改變了什麼、如何改變。

cues.en: It's just telling us the relative size of the difference in the output of the transformer blocks from the manipulated versus the clean version of the model.
cues.zh: 只告訴我們，操作與乾淨模型版本的 Transformer 區塊輸出，差異相對多大。

cues.en: Pretty remarkable to see that although I've only removed a one dimensional subspace from just the MLP
cues.zh: 很驚人，只從一層的 MLP

cues.en: sub block, from just one layer that had these ripple effects that kept increasing as we got further
cues.zh: 子區塊移除一維子空間，就有這些漣漪效應，而且越深入模型，

cues.en: into the model until the very end of the model, where the last transformer block plus the final layer norm seemed to have compensated for the differences quite a bit.
cues.zh: 影響越大，直到模型最末端，最後 Transformer 區塊加上最終 LayerNorm，似乎相當程度地補償了差異。

cues.en: I also looked at the impact of the removal on cosine similarity of token pairs at the level of the hidden states.
cues.zh: 我也看了，移除對隱藏狀態層級、token 配對餘弦相似度的影響。

cues.en: I don't have that figure right here, but it's something we will look at in the code.
cues.zh: 這裡沒有那張圖，但程式碼中會看。

cues.en: Okay, so this is just about the internal vectors in the model.
cues.zh: 好，這些只關於模型內部向量。

cues.en: Does this manipulation have any implications for the final output.
cues.zh: 操作是否影響最終輸出

cues.en: Logits.
cues.zh: logit？

cues.en: That's what I show in this plot here.
cues.zh: 這張圖就是。

cues.en: So this is the output logit from the manipulated version of the model relative to the clean version.
cues.zh: 這是操作模型版本，相對於乾淨版本的輸出 logit。

cues.en: And it's the logit for the next token prediction.
cues.zh: 針對下一個 token 的預測 logit。

cues.en: So a positive value in this difference metric here would mean that the clean model had a better prediction
cues.zh: 這個差值指標為正，表示乾淨模型對下一個

cues.en: for the next token, while a negative value would mean that the manipulated model had a better prediction for the next token in the sequence.
cues.zh: token 的預測較好；負值則表示，操作模型對序列下一個 token 預測較好。

cues.en: And of course the x axis here is the tokens in the sequence.
cues.zh: x 軸，當然是序列中的 token。

cues.en: We can also visualize these results as a text heatmap.
cues.zh: 也可以將結果視覺化為文字熱圖。

cues.en: Again, red tokens here mean that the clean model predicted the token better, and blue means that the subspace removed model predicted the tokens better.
cues.zh: 紅色 token，代表乾淨模型預測得較好；藍色，代表移除子空間模型預測得較好。

cues.en: Now, naively and at a fairly coarse grained level, we could expect that most of these data points would be above zero.
cues.zh: 從直觀、較粗略層次看，可以預期大部分資料點會在零以上。

cues.en: Visually, it's not super clear whether that's really obviously the case.
cues.zh: 視覺上，這是否真的明顯成立，並不太清楚。

cues.en: It is possible that just projecting out the largest principal component is not necessarily the optimal subspace to remove here.
cues.zh: 也許直接移除最大主成分，不一定是這裡最佳的移除子空間。

cues.en: It's also possible that the results differ in the different layers.
cues.zh: 也可能，不同層結果不同。

cues.en: So therefore the last analysis I ran was to repeat this procedure for all of the layers individually.
cues.zh: 所以，最後一項分析，是對所有層分別重複程序。

cues.en: Now this visualization here is fairly detailed to repeat 48 times for 48 transformer blocks.
cues.zh: 這個視覺化相當詳細，要對 48 個 Transformer 區塊重做 48 次。

cues.en: So what I did instead was run a t test across all of the logit differences for all the tokens, with
cues.zh: 所以，改成對所有 token 的全部 logit 差，做 t 檢定，

cues.en: the idea of seeing whether statistically, all of the tokens are different from zero at the kind of sentence level at the text level.
cues.zh: 看看從統計上，整個句子、文字層級的所有 token，是否異於零。

cues.en: And that's what you see in this graph here.
cues.zh: 這張圖就是。

cues.en: So here on the left plot, the x axis is the transformer block at which I ran the manipulation.
cues.zh: 左圖，x 軸是執行操作的 Transformer 區塊。

cues.en: And the y axis is the t value of the t test comparing all of the logit differences against zero.
cues.zh: y 軸，是對所有 logit 差與零比較的 t 檢定 t 值。

cues.en: So I did not separately calculate or visualize which of these tests were individually statistically
cues.zh: 我沒有另外計算或視覺化，哪些檢定個別在統計上

cues.en: significant, but in general, T values above somewhere around 2 or 3 will be significant.
cues.zh: 顯著；但一般，t 值大約超過二或三，就會顯著。

cues.en: But anyway, Qualitatively, it is certainly quite remarkable that the T test was positive for most of the layers where I manipulated the model.
cues.zh: 總之，從性質來看，大部分操作模型的層，t 檢定為正，相當值得注意。

cues.en: So there definitely is something consistent in this manipulation that is impairing the model's ability
cues.zh: 所以，這個操作確實有某種一致性，損害模型

cues.en: to utilize context and world knowledge to make predictions about subsequent tokens.
cues.zh: 運用上下文與世界知識，預測後續 token 的能力。

cues.en: Here in the middle panel, you see the percent variance explained by the largest component, and that
cues.zh: 中間面板，是最大成分解釋變異數的百分比，

cues.en: is how much of the data I removed in the subspace removal procedure.
cues.zh: 也就是子空間移除程序中，移除了多少資料。

cues.en: And except for the very first transformer block, it generally goes down as we get deeper into the model.
cues.zh: 除了最前面的 Transformer 區塊，整體而言，越深入模型就越低。

cues.en: This is actually entirely consistent with the effective dimensionality analyses that we've done several times before.
cues.zh: 這其實完全符合前面做過幾次的有效維度分析。

cues.en: There, the finding was that the dimensionality of the data increases as we get deeper into the model,
cues.zh: 當時發現，越深入模型，資料維度越高，

cues.en: which means that the amount of total variance that can be captured by just one component, just the top component that will kind of necessarily decrease.
cues.zh: 代表單一成分，也就是最大成分，能捕捉的總變異數比例，多少必然會下降。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And then I was curious whether there is any relationship between the variance explained by the top component
